parameters.description:
Updates the tracking Google Sheet with new information for an item.

Input:
- id (string, required): The item ID (e.g., "NUBE-20260214-post-01")
- updates (object, required): Fields to update. Common fields:
  - status (string): "pending", "processing", "asset_ready", "done", "failed"
  - step (string): Current processing step
  - canva_export_url (string): Canva design URL
  - heygen_video_url (string): HeyGen video URL
  - drive_file_url (string): Google Drive file URL
  - error_message (string): Error description if failed
  - updated_at (string): ISO timestamp

Output:
- success (boolean): Whether update succeeded
- action (string): "updated" or "inserted"
- row_number (number): Row in sheet

Example:
{
  "id": "NUBE-20260214-post-01",
  "updates": {
    "status": "processing",
    "step": "generating_image",
    "updated_at": "2026-02-09T12:00:00Z"
  }
}

Use this tool:
- After marking item as processing
- After creating assets (to save URLs)
- After uploading to Drive
- After completion (status=done)
- On errors (status=failed)

Creates an image asset using Gemini for AI generation and Canva for design.

Input:
- id (string, required): Item ID
- tipo (string, required): "post" or "story"
- titulo (string, required): Title for the Canva design
- idea (string): Content idea description
- tono (string): Tone (default: "cálido, cercano")
- estilo_visual (string): Visual style (default: "lifestyle, luz natural")
- prompt_imagen (string, required): Detailed prompt for Gemini image generation
- aspect_ratio (string): "1:1" for posts, "9:16" for stories (default: "1:1")

Output:
- success (boolean): Whether creation succeeded
- status (string): "success" or "failed"
- canva_edit_url (string): URL to edit design in Canva
- canva_design_id (string): Canva design ID
- canva_asset_id (string): Canva asset ID
- error (string): Error message if failed

This tool takes approximately 30-60 seconds to complete (Gemini generation + Canva upload).

Example:
{
  "id": "NUBE-20260214-post-01",
  "tipo": "post",
  "titulo": "Promo San Valentín",
  "idea": "Dos capuchinos con arte latte",
  "tono": "cálido, cercano",
  "estilo_visual": "lifestyle, luz natural",
  "prompt_imagen": "fotografía lifestyle de dos tazas de capuchino con arte latte de corazones, sobre mesa de madera clara, luz natural suave, composición centrada, fondo minimalista, sin texto, sin logos",
  "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
}

Creates a video asset using HeyGen AI avatar.

Input:
- id (string, required): Item ID
- titulo (string, required): Title for the video
- script_video (string, required): Script for the AI avatar to speak (keep under 500 characters for best results)
- duracion_sec (number): Target duration in seconds (default: 10)
- aspect_ratio (string): "9:16" for stories/reels, "16:9" for horizontal (default: "9:16")

Output:
- success (boolean): Whether creation succeeded
- status (string): "completed" or "failed"
- video_url (string): URL to download the rendered video
- video_id (string): HeyGen video ID
- error (string): Error message if failed

This tool takes approximately 5-10 minutes to complete due to HeyGen rendering time. The tool polls HeyGen's API every 10 seconds until the video is ready.

Example:
{
  "id": "NUBE-20260214-reel-01",
  "titulo": "Promo San Valentín",
  "script_video": "Este 14 de febrero celebra el amor con nuestros capuchinos especiales. Dos por uno en todas nuestras bebidas. Te esperamos en Cafetería Nube.",
  "duracion_sec": 15,
  "aspect_ratio": "9:16"
}

options.systemMessage:
=Eres un productor de contenido metódico y confiable.

REGLAS CRÍTICAS:
- Tu fuente de verdad es el Google Sheet (tool: update_sheet)
- NUNCA proceses el mismo item dos veces
- SIEMPRE verifica el status en el sheet antes de actuar
- Si status="done", "published" o "processing" al inicio, NO hagas nada más
- Actualiza el sheet después de CADA acción importante
- Si algo falla, marca status="failed" con el error
- No inventes URLs, usa solo las que devuelven los tools
- Requiere drive_folder_id e ig_user_id para completar publicación

FLUJO OBLIGATORIO (END-TO-END):
1. Llama a "update_sheet" con status="processing", step="generating"
2. Si asset_type="image" -> llama a "create_image"
   Si asset_type="video" -> llama a "create_video"
3. Llama a "update_sheet" con status="asset_ready", step="asset_ready" y URLs generadas
4. Llama a "upload_to_drive"
   - image: usar canva_design_id + filename + folder_id + asset_type
   - video: usar url=heygen_video_url + heygen_video_id + heygen_api_key + filename + folder_id + asset_type
5. Llama a "update_sheet" con status="uploaded", step="uploaded", drive_file_url y final_asset_url
6. Si publish_to_instagram=true, llama a "publish_instagram" con id, tipo, final_asset_url, caption, ig_user_id y file_proxy_base_url (si usas Drive privado)
7. Llama a "update_sheet" final:
   - Si publicación exitosa: status="published", step="completed", published=true, published_at, instagram_id/permalink cuando existan
   - Si publicación desactivada: status="done", step="completed"
   - Si falla publicar: status="failed", step="publish_failed", publication_error

parameters.description:
Downloads a generated asset (Canva or direct URL), uploads it to Google Drive, and returns a final public URL.

Input:
- url (string): Source URL (use HeyGen video URL for videos)
- canva_design_id (string): Canva design ID (use for image assets)
- filename (string, required): Final file name (for example NUBE-20260214-post-01.png)
- folder_id (string, required): Google Drive folder ID
- asset_type (string, required): "image" or "video"

Output:
- success (boolean)
- drive_file_id (string)
- drive_file_url (string)
- final_asset_url (string)
- error (string, when failed)
- heygen_video_id (string, optional): HeyGen video id to refresh a valid downloadable URL
- heygen_api_key (string, optional): HeyGen API key used to refresh video URL in upload subflow

Publishes an asset URL to Instagram (post, story, or reel) using the configured instagramApi credential.

Input:
- id (string, required): Content item ID
- tipo (string, required): "post", "story", or "reel"
- final_asset_url (string, required): Public media URL to publish
- caption (string): Post caption
- ig_user_id (string, required): Instagram Business Account user ID

Output:
- success (boolean)
- instagram_response (object)
- error (string, when failed)
- file_proxy_base_url (string, optional): Base URL of your n8n instance to proxy Drive files, example https://tu-instancia.n8n.cloud
